items.title: Building an AEO scoring pipeline with AWS Lambda durable functions
items.summary: Learn how to build a five-step Agent Engine Optimization (AEO) scoring pipeline on AWS Lambda durable functions. Each checkpointed step suspends without incurring costs between stages and retries without re-spending on prior work, so you can score any page against five AEO signals and deploy the solution with an AWS SAM template.
items.creator: Nick Beall
